Commentary: Marco Jansen to Travis Head, 1 run, short and into the body, Head awkwardly tucks it behind square on the on-side for a single
Looks like the sun has come out once again at Kingsmead and we could have some more play today

Wiaan Mulder to Travis Head, FOUR, runs continue to flow for Australia - the inswinger from Mulder, but he's drifted onto the pads - Head was a tad early into the clip, hits it in the air and into the gap wide of mid-wicket
Wiaan Mulder to Travis Head, no run, on a good length and slanting across the left-hander, left alone
Wiaan Mulder to Travis Head, no run, length ball that's pushed across the left-hander, left alone
Wiaan Mulder to Travis Head, no run, beauty, Mulder goes full and pushes one across the left-hander - Head almost walked into the drive and he's beaten by the angle
Wiaan Mulder to Travis Head, no run, fuller length delivery on off - Head prods across and defends it to the on-side
Wiaan Mulder to Travis Head, no run, fuller length delivery outside off - driven hard and to the left of cover where the fielder makes an acrobatic stop - Harmer, it is
Marco Jansen to Nic Maddinson, no run, Jansen shortens the length and pushes one across the left-hander, has Maddinson sparring at that and goes past the outside edge
Marco Jansen to Nic Maddinson, 1 run, length ball on the pads, tucked through mid-wicket for a single

Marco Jansen to Travis Head, leg byes, FOUR, too straight from Jansen, the angle takes it on the pads and Travis Head helps it on its way with a tickle, goes fine and past the diving keeper. Given as leg byes though

Marco Jansen to Travis Head, FOUR, lovely, back of a length and well wide of off - Head gets on top of the bounce and then punches it in front of square on the off-side, beats cover and runs away to the ropes
Marco Jansen to Travis Head, no run, on a good length and just outside off - Head gets right behind the line in defence
Marco Jansen to Travis Head, no run, fuller length delivery outside off - driven straight to the fielder at mid-off
Wiaan Mulder to Nic Maddinson, no run, beaten, Mulder shortens the length and pushes one across the left-hander - Maddinson plays well away from hid body and is beaten on the outside edge
Wiaan Mulder to Nic Maddinson, no run, on a good length and just outside off - Maddinson presses across on the defensive push

Wiaan Mulder to Nic Maddinson, SIX, cracking shot, Ricketon at deep backward square doesn't pick it, but it didn't matter - the ball sailed deep into the stands for a maximum. Was full and at the pads, Maddinson got inside the line and whipped it stylishly
Wiaan Mulder to Nic Maddinson, no run, on a good length and angling across the left-hander, Maddinson plays inside the line and lets it go
